reason: The 45-meetings logistics case gets my attention, but six weeks of profiles, positioning and setup before anything proven reaches my calendar sounds like the strategy deck I don't need. I'd take a call this month, not sign one.
objection: No meeting number is guaranteed, so I could be EUR 7,000 in after the sprint and two months of running it and still be guessing at my cost per meeting. One case study I can't check isn't payback maths.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to that logistics client directly, plus a written cost-per-qualified-meeting target with part of the Run fee refunded if they miss it.
